SOCIAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Enterprise Project at School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Enterprise Project at School never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Enterprise Project at School as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Enterprise Project at School.
   D. Explain Enterprise Project at School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Industries in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Industries in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Industries in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Industries in the County.
   D. Treat Industries in the County as rumours only.

3. Which statement about Economic activities in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Economic activities in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Economic activities in the County as rumours only.
   C. Say Economic activities in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Economic activities in the County.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Littering in markets

5. Which statement about Interdependence of people is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Interdependence of people.
   B. Explain Interdependence of people with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Interdependence of people as rumours only.
   D. Say Interdependence of people never happens in Kenya.

6. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Kisumu

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Which statement about Seasons in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Seasons in the County as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Seasons in the County.
   C. Say Seasons in the County never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Seasons in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County..
   D. Explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Replace the compass rose
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

11. Which statement about Population Distribution is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Distribution never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Population Distribution as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Distribution.
   D. Explain Population Distribution with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about The School is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat The School as rumours only.
   B. Explain The School with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say The School never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing The School.

13. Which statement about Location and size of the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Location and size of the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Location and size of the County as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Location and size of the County.
   D. Say Location and size of the County never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Compass Direction is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Compass Direction never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Compass Direction.
   C. Treat Compass Direction as rumours only.
   D. Explain Compass Direction with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

15. Which statement about Historic Built Environments in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historic Built Environments in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Historic Built Environments in the County never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Historic Built Environments in the County.
   D. Treat Historic Built Environments in the County as rumours only.

16. Which statement about Physical features in the County is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Physical features in the County never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Physical features in the County with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Physical features in the County as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Physical features in the County.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Interdependence of people and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Population Distribution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Aspects of Traditional Culture in the County. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain The School and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Economic activities in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Industries in the County and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
